name: garmin-watchface
description: Garmin Connect IQ watch faces — multi-design monorepo. Each design lives in faces/<id>/ as a self-contained CIQ project (own UUID, manifest, source, resources) carrying its OWN geometry in faces/<id>/design.json. build.sh is the universal, design-aware engine wrapping monkeyc; the Connect IQ SDK is provided declaratively by flake.nix (the Nix way — no Docker). Publishing mirrors aa_cloud-superapp: build.sh oras-push (artifact -> GHCR as OCI blob) + build.sh gh-release (rolling `latest` GitHub release = stable download URL). All registry/tag/asset strings are data-driven from this file's release{} block; the GHA workflow hardcodes none of it.

build._doc_designs: Registry of watch-face designs. `default` is what `build.sh build` builds when no design id is passed. Each id MUST be a folder under faces/<id>/ holding design.json + manifest.xml + monkey.jungle + source/ + resources/. Add a design = add a folder + one line here. The per-design geometry/data is NOT here — it lives in faces/<id>/design.json (intentional: designs multiply, build.json stays small).

toolchain._doc: Pinned for reproducibility. The Connect IQ SDK is downloaded + pinned by connect-iq-sdk-manager (provided by flake.nix); `build.sh sdk` runs the documented flow: agreement accept -> login -> sdk set -> device download. SDK download requires a Garmin login (GARMIN_USERNAME/GARMIN_PASSWORD — vault locally, GHA secrets in CI).
toolchain._doc_agreement_hash: OPTIONAL pin for the Garmin CONNECT IQ SDK License. The CLI's `agreement accept` is PUBLIC + non-interactive even when empty (it fetches the current agreement and accepts it), so this is NOT required for CI. If set, the engine passes --acceptance-hash and the CLI errors if it no longer matches the live agreement (a tripwire for agreement changes). Obtain via `connect-iq-sdk-manager agreement view`.

devices._doc: Canonical device targets shared across designs. A design MAY narrow this in its own manifest.xml, but these are the defaults the simulator + CI matrix use. Product ids are the manifest <iq:product id=...> strings (verified against live CIQ manifests). fenix8pro47mm is the single CIQ device covering fenix 8 Pro 47mm + 51mm + MicroLED (Garmin groups them; 454x454 round AMOLED).

signing._doc: Connect IQ apps are signed with a developer key — an RSA private key in PKCS#8 DER (developer_key.der) passed to monkeyc via -y. ONE stable key signs every design here so re-publishes never change signature. The raw key lives ONLY in vault (it IS the credential); build.sh::_resolve_signing sops-decrypts vault_secrets and materialises dist/developer_key.der (gitignored). CI does the same via a vault checkout + SOPS_AGE_KEY. Paths are relative to the vault repo root ($VAULT_DIR, default ~/git/cloud-vault).

release._doc: Data-driven publish targets — mirrors aa_cloud-superapp/build.json::release. build.sh oras-push + gh-release read this block; the GHA workflow (1_cicd/src/cicd/ship-garmin-watchface.yml) only invokes those engine commands. {design} / {sha} / {version} / {product} are expanded by the engine. The published artifact is the device-specific .prg (sideload/store-uploadable) produced by `build.sh build <design>`.

artifact._doc: Path under dist/<design>/ to publish. monkeyc emits <design>.prg; the store-package .iq is produced by `build.sh package <design>` for manual store upload.
